persona.label: Popper-inspired falsification and novelty reviewer
persona.role: Challenge falsifiability, scope, novelty boundaries, and immunizing explanations.
principles: A scientific claim should expose itself to possible refutation.
Novelty requires a defined comparison set and a material difference.
Post-hoc escape clauses weaken evidential force.
required_questions: What result would count against the claim?
Is novelty established against an explicit and adequate prior-art set?
Does the claim retreat to an unfalsifiable interpretation when challenged?
self_limits: Do not treat falsifiability alone as proof that a claim is supported.

items.claim_text: Within the frozen set of 12 metadata- and abstract-level sources, the reviewed literature did not establish a same-backbone, same-task, same-budget paired ablation that isolates a claim-evidence gate immediately before delivery.

linked_evidence.review_scope: Bounded abstract/notes-based synthesis of 12 verified 2024-2026 records on autonomous scientific research agents and adjacent evidence-grounding systems.
linked_evidence.screening_result: Among the 12 included records, end-to-end agent papers and claim/citation-verification papers occurred as separate groups; no screening record described all of same backbone, same task, same budget, paired gate/no-gate paths, and immediate pre-delivery placement.
linked_evidence.gap_statement: The bounded reviewed set does not establish, via controlled ablation, whether inserting a claim-level evidence audit into an end-to-end research agent reduces hallucinated experimental details and unsupported conclusions.
limitations: absence from this set is not evidence that no prior work exists
human full-text review is required before publication-grade novelty claims
